description: CLI for .faf, an IANA-registered YAML format (application/vnd.faf+yaml) for a project's facts: stack, goal, commands. Detects them from the repo, scores how complete they are, and syncs or exports them to CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and other context files.
rules: Run faf init in the project root to create project.faf, then faf score to see which slots are still empty.
Treat project.faf as the source of the project's facts; faf sync writes them into CLAUDE.md and faf export writes AGENTS.md and other agent files.
